name: HF optimum-neuron on AWS inf2.xlarge: Llama2 7B (budget config, bs1), 32 tok/s at 256 new tokens
methodology: VENDOR-ADJACENT MEASURED (Hugging Face optimum-neuron team, huggingface.co/blog/inferentia-llama2). AWS inf2.xlarge (1 Inferentia2 chip), model Neuron-compiled for max_seq 2048, input 256 tokens + 256 generated tokens, batch 1. Throughput = batch*(input+output)/e2e-latency per the blog's convention — aggregate, not per-request decode. Latency-oriented Neuron compile (bs1).
notes: Numbers from the published throughput table at 256 new tokens (256-input). Compiled-model Neuron SDK figures — no llama.cpp/vLLM path exists on Inferentia. inf2.48xlarge = 12x Inferentia2 chips over NeuronLink v2; the 24-core compile uses 2 chips' worth of cores (each chip has 2 NeuronCores v2) — per the blog all non-budget configs span the full instance.
